notes: On a title's store page, when the release lists both a Setup installer and a portable exe at the same version, you now get Install Desktop and Get Portable. Get Portable downloads the standalone exe, checks its SHA-256, and saves it to Downloads. AGE OF CHICS™ BY HYPERION 2.5.1 shows both builds this way. The H icon, Desktop shortcut and portable-on-Desktop Setup, and the AGE OF CHICS featured/library pin, are unchanged.
